ValidationRule.description: Method value is required when SubType is Discovery Call and Status is Completed
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT( $Permission.Bypass_Method_on_Completed_Discovery_Call_Event ) ,ISBLANK(TEXT( NSP_Method__c )) ,ISPICKVAL( NSP_Event_Subtype__c, "Discovery Call" ) ,ISCHANGED( NSP_Status__c ) ,ISPICKVAL( NSP_Status__c, "Completed" ) ,BEGINS( WhatId ,'006') )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Please choose a value for Method when completing a Discovery Call
